from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

# The 8 specific cause-of-action categories defined in the task
Category = Literal[
    "与公司，证券，保险，票据等有关的民事纠纷",
    "行政行为-其他行政行为",
    "执行案由-民事",
    "妨碍社会管理秩序罪",
    "行政行为-行政复议",
    "侵犯公民人身权利,民主权利罪",
    "知识产权与竞争纠纷",
    "执行案由-先予执行"
]

class DocumentCase(BaseModel):
    """Represents one document and its classification category."""
    title: str = Field(description="The actual title of the judgment document")
    category: Category = Field(description="The cause of action category for this document as indicated in the summary")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentCase] = Field(description="List of all documents with their assigned categories")
